name: Case Editor saves a manual eval case that is listed as never run
description: From /agents, open the seeded Security Reviewer agent, switch to its Evals tab and activate New eval case: the Case Editor opens titled New eval case (SPEC-06 AC1). Write the fixed case e2e-manual-case (a one-hunk diff of src/e2e.ts, must not flag, lines 2-2, expected output left at its default []), wait for the debounced parse to offer the file, and Save once the button is enabled. The dialog stays open titled Eval case · e2e-manual-case; Escape closes it and the new row reads never run (SPEC-06 AC9). This is the suite's one write, an accepted exception to coverage-spec.md rule 1: it adds one case to the seeded agent, runs last, is read by no other flow and assumes the hermetic empty DB (a rerun against a long-lived dev DB fails on name_taken). No model call: no run control (in the dialog, on a row or for the whole set) is clicked, and the run-after-save toggle stays at its default, off.
